name: Knowledge
summary: Your notes as Knowledge: connect the folders of notes you keep (an Obsidian vault, any folder of Markdown); Echo describes each one for Claude, you correct it, and Claude in Echo knows where to look

agent.summary: The user's Knowledge vaults (Obsidian vaults and other folders of notes): which vault to look in, asking Echo's index of them, adding notes in each vault's own way

settings.label: Where the twin preset puts its twin skill
settings.help: vault: the new vault's own .claude/skills; global: your own Claude Code (~/.claude/skills), for every session — Knowledge shows it to you first and adds it only when you click Install

settings.label: Sites Knowledge reads pages from
settings.help: Addresses of sites, comma-separated (https://wiki.acme.example): a page there is read as soon as you add it in Ingest. Any other page, Echo asks you for its address in its own box
